The normal head impulse test makes vestibular neuritis less likely, so I need to rule out central causes like a stroke or multiple sclerosis. Do you have any difficulty with coordination, such as trouble buttoning a shirt or dropping objects, or any changes in your speech or swallowing?

text:
The negative Dix-Hallpike rules out BPPV, and with central causes excluded by the MRI, we are likely looking at a persistent peripheral vestibular issue. Since the head impulse was normal, could this be Vestibular Migraine or the recovery phase of Labyrinthitis? Please confirm if you have a history of migraines or if your dizziness improves gradually when you focus on a fixed visual point.
